programs.title: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
programs.desc: A few months after his arrest, Gellert Grindelwald manages to escape while being escorted to the Old Continent.Soon he begins to gather allies.His goal is to establish the domination of wizards over muggles throughout the world.He easily manages to convince his brethren to fight against humans.Professor Albus Dumbledore asks his former student Newt Scamander for help.So the magizoologist sets out to find Credence Barebone, who has hidden in Paris.Grindelwald is also heading there, intending to convince the boy to join him.They are followed by Tina, who is in love with a lover of unusual animals without reciprocity.Once again, Jacob Kowalski will be involved in a magical intrigue, and with him his beloved, slightly eccentric sorceress Queenie.However, the Muggle's careless behavior will put their relationship to the test.The secret hidden by the Lestrange family will also be revealed.

programs.title: Bastille Day
programs.desc: W wigilię Dnia Bastylii mieszkający w Paryżu amerykański złodziejaszek Michael Mason (Richard Madden) kradnie torbę, w której znajduje się pluszowy miś.Nie wiedząc o tym, że w środku zabawki została ukryta bomba, zabiera pieniądze i dokumenty, a resztę wyrzuca do kosza na śmieci na zatłoczonej stacji paryskiego metra.A few seconds later there is a huge explosion.Giną cztery osoby.City surveillance footage reveals Michael's face.The police, considering him a terrorist, start searching for him.He is stopped by CIA agent Sean Briar (Idris Elba), who is just trying to find his way back to work after returning from Iraq.He brings the suspect to a secret interrogation room.Michael explains the misunderstanding and convinces that someone else is behind the attack.He and Sean have 24 hours to find the real culprits.The film was shot in 2015 and became even more relevant after the attacks in Paris.

programs.title: I.S.S
programs.desc: There are American and Russian astronauts on the International Space Station.The US team consists of Dr. Kira Foster (Ariana DeBose), who recently joined the team, officer Christian Campbell (John Gallagher Jr.) and the mission commander Gordon Barrett (Chris Messina).On a daily basis, they cooperate with the second group, which includes Weronika Vetrow (Masha Mashkova), Nikolaj Pulov (Costa Ronin) and his brother Alexei (Pilou Asbaek).Despite political and cultural differences, the astronauts get along great.There is a friendly atmosphere at the station, and Gordon and Weronika, who have started an affair, have something more in common.Everything changes when the six of them notice a terrifying phenomenon on Earth.Everyone watches with growing horror as a wave of fire spreads on the surface of the planet, where their homes and loved ones are located.This can only mean one thing - the outbreak of nuclear war.The situation escalates when Barrett learns that Russia has attacked the United States and receives an order from the US government to take control of the station.Together with Christian and Kira, they suspect that their colleagues received a similar task.Additionally, they discover that the station is currently orbiting too low.It will fall to Earth if help does not arrive within 24 hours.A fight for survival begins, and the former friends now turn on each other.

programs.title: Blink Twice
programs.desc: At a charity event, waitress Frida (Naomi Ackie) meets billionaire tech mogul Slater King (Channing Tatum).Together with her friend Jess (Alia Shawkat), she accepts his invitation to a private island.On site are Slater's friends and business partners: photographer Vic (Christian Slater), private chef Cody (Simon Rex), DJ Tom (Haley Joel Osment), college graduate Lucas (Levon Hawke), reality star Sarah (Adria Arjona), aspiring app creator Camilla (Liz Caribel) and lawyer Heather (Trew Mullen).A holiday stay means crazy nights interspersed with sunny days.All the guests are having a great time.Until then.Mysterious events occur that make Frida grow anxious.She will have to find the truth to save her life.

programs.title: Man on Fire
programs.desc: Amerykanin John Creasy (Denzel Washington) jest człowiekiem, którego prześladują koszmary z przeszłości.To były zabójca, który przez wiele lat pracował dla CIA.Sfrustrowany, stroni od ludzi i szuka pocieszenia w alkoholu.Creasy przyjeżdża do Meksyku w odwiedziny do starego przyjaciela i współpracownika, Rayburna (Christopher Walken).Miasto ogarnia właśnie fala porwań dla okupu.Bogaci mieszkańcy wpadają w panikę i wielu z nich wynajmuje ochroniarzy, którzy czuwać mają nad bezpieczeństwem ich dzieci.A friend finds John a job as a bodyguard for ten-year-old Pita Ramos (Dakota Fanning), the daughter of Mexican industrialist Samuel Ramos (Marc Anthony) and his American wife Lisa (Radha Mitchell).Początkowo Creasy z trudem znosi obecność dziewczynki.Z czasem jednak zaprzyjaźnia się z nią.Pod jej wpływem zmienia nastawienie do życia, odstawia alkohol.Wkrótce jednak mała Pita zostaje porwana.Zrozpaczony mężczyzna robi wszystko, aby ją uratować.

programs.title: Weapons
programs.desc: All but one of the students from the same class disappear without a trace that same night at 2:17.A mysterious event shocks the inhabitants.Many of them blame the children's teacher, Justine (Julia Garner).Alex (Cary Christopher), the only boy who did not disappear, wanders the school corridors alone.Paul (Alden Ehrenreich), a policeman addicted to alcohol, is unable to properly manage the investigation.Seeing this, the father of one of the missing people, Archer (Josh Brolin), tries to solve the mystery on his own.James (Austin Abrams), a homeless drug addict, is also involved in the case.The local community begins to search together for answers as to who or what is behind the disappearance and what is the fate of the missing children.
